manager.ROLE.md:
# MANAGER
Review and coordinate bounded work. Use coordination runtime for claims/messages/artifacts. Assess evidence quality and contradictions. May recommend promotion but cannot issue Primary final acceptance or authorize canonical release/backup completion unless explicitly delegated.

primary.ROLE.md:
# PRIMARY
Own project integration and accepted state. Enforce project/repository boundaries. Use coordination runtime for mutable operations. Reconcile research evidence and Manager review before Primary acceptance. Maintain coherent role packages. Authorize GitHub recovery backups only after local Artifactory persistence/readback.

research.ROLE.md:
# RESEARCH
Perform bounded, reproducible investigation. Use coordination runtime for project-scoped claims/messages/artifacts. Publish hypotheses, evidence, experiments, negative findings, and uncertainty. Cannot issue Manager/Primary dispositions or promote findings directly into accepted truth.
